description: Semantic search over upcoming events in Paris and Île-de-France. The query can be in any language and describe a need ("rainy day activity for a 4 year old", "jazz gratuit", "亲子手工"). Returns up to 10 events, best match first, nearest first when a location is given.

lang.description: Language of titles and summaries. Default: en.

near_lat.description: Latitude to search around (optional, with near_lon).

near_lon.description: Longitude to search around (optional, with near_lat).

query.description: What the user is looking for, in natural language.

radius_km.description: Only with near_lat/near_lon: keep events within this distance.

name: search_events
title: Search events in Paris region
